note: Small rustic campground in a mountain valley by Island Lake, beside Hwy 3 about 14 km west of Coleman in the Crowsnest Pass. Self-registration, cash/cheque. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Apr 24, 2026): 36 unserviced FCFS sites at C$23 (count 40 -> 36), vault toilets, non-potable pump; season corrected from the approximate May-Oct to May 8 - Oct 14. Not waterfront kept. Phone differs from the page.
flags: PHONE: stored 403-563-5395; the page's 'Information: 403-627-1165'. Recommend 403-627-1165. No Facility Operator line.
SENIORS: the page carries 'This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.' (not in the provincial:AB row).

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - keep; contrary claim logged): the page says 'Campsites provide a mix of mountain or lake views'. On imagery the sites line a linear gravel loop running SE from about 49.6285,-114.6713 toward 49.6268,-114.6688, inside forest between the railway and Hwy 3; the lake's open water is ~120-150 m west of the loop's NW end and ~250-300 m from most sites, through forest and a marshy edge. No on-water; a lake view from a few NW sites is possible but not visible on imagery and no site is named.

PIN (49.62850,-114.67130): at the campground's north entrance, ~170 m from the loop's middle (about 49.6275,-114.6700) - within tolerance. The page's directions point 49.630701,-114.675037 is ~350 m NW of the sites, near the railway. Website (200) is the camping page; no shop link is stored and the page marks it first-come, first-served.
